selection_analysis.rationale: Verifier-report unlock is broad across eleven families and not a tight batch. Provider-attempt primary core has denser shared scenarios than model-output primary core: 10 closed provider-attempt primary cases across 6 receipts versus 10 closed model-output primary cases across 8 receipts. The selected retry subcluster puts four provider-attempt-primary requirements plus one identity requirement on the same provider-visible-retry receipt and reuses the existing retry occurrence predicate.

intent: Execute only the visible-retry occurrence core: distinct attempt identity, positive retry orchestration basis, and retry non-negation. Predecessor cycle, failover, hedge, adapter-capture, and model-output semantics remain unimplemented.
